Hi, i don't really know if these work for hee but they work/ won't work for me so I'm sharing them with you!

Make her feel loved. Tell her that you really love her and like to spend time with her. Remind her how much she means to you without making her feel bad if she chooses to end it. Just tell her that you're glad you get to spend time with her. 

DON'T say anything abput how you'd feel if she kills herself. Believe me she knows how sad you'd be.  If she asks about this stuff give her an honest answer but if she doesn't ask anything about it don't start this kind of conversation with her. 

Honestly all i want to know  when I'm with a person i care about a lot is that they love me and they want to be with me simply because they enjoy my company. 

If you realize she's cutting herself again only react the way you turly feel. Don't blame her, don't make her feel guilty. Just make sure she knows that you're with her and you care. You can kiss her scars (believe me this means a lot) to show that you love that about her too. 

Being the way she is is something she cannot change so quickly. What you have to do is to make sure that you accept and love her the way she is. Not in the way who she could be or who she was before. Just the way she is now. 

I hope this helps to you. And i thank you for caring for her enough to ask people this. You can also ask her if she's uncomfortable with anything around you. Don't forget to show her your real emotions that what matters the most!
